hook: A 3D-printed ceramic optical bench holds a rubidium frequency reference in just 6 mL

readout.label: Laser fractional frequency instability at 1 s

summary: Researchers 3D-print monolithic ceramic optical benches, then align and glue optics onto them to build compact atomic sensors. A rubidium reference in a 6 mL alumina module stabilizes a laser to 3e-12 fractional instability at 1 s. The magnetometer and optical trap are designs or early demonstrators, with performance not yet shown in the field or space.
title: Additively manufactured ceramic platforms for miniaturized optical frequency references and robust atomic sensor systems
